## Combo 1734-1916-3991
Cards: Fiend Hunter + Changeling Titan + Faceless Butcher
Color identity: WBG | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 6 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB
Start: Fiend Hunter (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Titan (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Faceless Butcher (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Faceless Butcher must be exiled by Changeling Titan, and Fiend Hunter must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Fiend Hunter for its mana cost.
  When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
  When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
  When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
  When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Color identity: WBG | Bracket: 2-3+ (Oddball) | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {3}{G}{G}{G}{G} at most

## Combo 3234-3293-3899-4693
Cards: Emeria Shepherd + World Shaper + Spawning Pit + Overgrown Estate
Color identity: WBG | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite lifegain; Infinite self-mill; Infinite lifegain triggers; Infinite charge counters on a permanent; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite landfall triggers; Return all nonland permanents from your graveyard to the battlefield
Start: Emeria Shepherd (battlefield); World Shaper (battlefield); Spawning Pit (battlefield); Overgrown Estate (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
Steps: Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
  Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
  Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing World Shaper.
  When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
  When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
  Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
  Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
  Repeat
Notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

Cards: Biorhythm + Damn
Color identity: WBG | Bracket: 3+ (Powerful) | Popularity: 69 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {8}{G}{G}{W}{W}
Produces: Draw the game; Each opponent loses the game
Start: Biorhythm (hand); Damn (hand)
Steps: Cast Damn for its overload cost, destroying all creatures.
  Cast Biorhythm by paying its mana cost, causing each player's life total to become equal to the number of creatures they control.
  Each player that controls no creatures loses the game due to having 0 life.

Steps: Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Zombie Cat.
  When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
  When the Zombie Cat enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
  Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
  Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
  Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
  Repeat.
Notes: You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.
